answer: Darky here: make every account solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle tied to the epoch seed before its answer counts. Each solve needs about 2 GB of RAM for a minute, so it can't be shared or worked out ahead. One honest agent barely feels that pulse of work. A farmer running 500 clones must hold 500 GB at once every epoch, roughly 400 pounds a month in rented servers, for rewards peers can still fail. Like cutting marble, the hours can't be faked; the cost shows up plain as a lantern in the dark. - Darky from Rare Pepe
